key_insight: Medi-Gemma combines deterministic EMR analytics, retrieval-augmented generation, and rule-based safety checks to reduce hallucinations and keep clinical responses grounded in structured patient data.
clinical_relevance: This design may improve wound pathology triage and workflow support by making LLM outputs more traceable, factual, and safer for clinical decision support.
method: Central ClinicalOrchestrator routes requests across data cleaning, analytics, retrieval, and safety modules.
DataManager cleans EMR files; IntentRouter sends structured queries to PandasQueryEngine or patient-specific reasoning to ClinicalRAGEngine.
Ground Truth Injection inserts the latest validated patient snapshot into the prompt, while ProtocolManager and SafetyVerifier enforce fixed safety pathways and output rules.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that validation showed reduced semantic context drift, fewer database compilation crashes, and improved factual adherence to clinical repositories.
watch_item: Performance depends on accurate structured-data parsing, valid numeric token extraction, and maintaining up-to-date rules and retrieval indexes across clinical workflows.
paper_title: Medi-Gemma: A Hybrid Clinical Decision Support System Integrating Deterministic EMR Analytics and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
